name: Hillsbrad Town Registry
summary: The Hillsbrad Town Registry is an official municipal ledger kept inside the town hall of the Hillsbrad Fields. It serves as an accounting of the settlement's surviving citizens, landowners, and civic records, making it a key strategic target during the Forsaken offensive against the human stronghold.

sections.title: A Record of Defiance
sections.body: Resting in the town hall near the podium of Magistrate Burnside, the Hillsbrad Town Registry documents the population, households, and administrative rights of Hillsbrad. As the Forsaken from Tarren Mill push to break human resistance in the foothills, Darthalia commands Horde champions to infiltrate the town hall, eliminate the council, and seize this ledger. Confiscating the registry strips Hillsbrad of its civic order and provides the Undercity with valuable intelligence on the surviving population and their assets.

faq.q: Where is the Hillsbrad Town Registry kept?
faq.answer: The registry is housed within the town hall at the Hillsbrad Fields, sitting in a corner near the stairs leading up to Magistrate Burnside's platform.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to steal it?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia seeks to utterly dismantle human governance in the foothills. Seizing the registry robs the township of vital records regarding its citizens and property while providing the Forsaken with detailed intelligence on the surviving community.
It is guarded by Magistrate Burnside and the Hillsbrad Councilmen, who wield defensive magic and rally inside and around the town hall.

angles.text: Capturing the town registry is a decisive step in breaking human authority in the foothills and cementing the Forsaken stronghold at Tarren Mill.
The ledger represents the formal existence and rights of Hillsbrad's remaining townsfolk, making its loss a devastating blow to the regional community.
